## Chillscreen: in time with the music, real records, a new clock
- **Transitions to the music:** choose Off, On the beat or On the bar (every 4 beats) under Settings → Chillscreen. "On the beat" is now on by default. The beat is predicted ahead from the tempo of the song, so the cut lands exactly on the beat instead of a moment later
- **Smoother camera:** shots keep moving to the very end instead of braking to a stop, slow and quick shots take turns, and about one in five circles around its subject
- **Real records:** the records in the shelf have real spines now: mostly white, black and cardboard, a few coloured, with a printed title and catalogue number, and the thickness of real sleeves
- **New wall clock:** a turned metal case, a finely printed dial with minute marks and numbers, 3D hands with a sweeping second hand and glass on top. The little speaker below got a real woofer and tweeter
- **Pin the player:** a pin button at the top keeps the mini player at the bottom visible all the time, or lets it fade out again

The room on the website got the same update.

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
